notes.de: Session-Key = user_pseudo_id + ga_session_id; Purchase-Revenue aus Params/Items.
notes.en: Session key = user_pseudo_id + ga_session_id; purchase revenue from params/items.

sqlExamples.sql:
CREATE TABLE curated_fct_ga4_event AS
SELECT
  e.event_date,
  e.event_timestamp,
  e.event_name,
  e.user_pseudo_id,
  e.user_id,
  e.ga_session_id,
  CONCAT(e.user_pseudo_id, '-', CAST(e.ga_session_id AS VARCHAR)) AS session_key,
  e.device_category,
  e.geo_country,
  e.traffic_source,
  e.traffic_medium,
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.param_key = 'value' THEN COALESCE(p.param_float, CAST(p.param_int AS DOUBLE)) END) AS event_value,
  MAX(CASE WHEN p.param_key = 'currency' THEN p.param_string END) AS currency_code
FROM raw_ga4_event e
LEFT JOIN raw_ga4_event_param p
  ON p.event_timestamp = e.event_timestamp
 AND p.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
 AND p.event_name = e.event_name
GROUP BY
  e.event_date, e.event_timestamp, e.event_name, e.user_pseudo_id, e.user_id,
  e.ga_session_id, e.device_category, e.geo_country, e.traffic_source, e.traffic_medium;

notes.de: MTTR = resolved_at − opened_at; Open = state not closed/resolved per process definition.
notes.en: MTTR = resolved_at − opened_at; open = state not closed/resolved per process definition.

sqlExamples.sql:

  sys_id AS incident_id,
  number,
  state,
  priority,

  caller_id,
  assignment_group,
  assigned_to,
